scenario: A flatmate pays a flat expense; the user and another flatmate owe their shares (scenario-analysis.md #26, ADR-0006 — bidirectional payer)

evidence.raw_text: Flatmate A: 'paid the electrician, 3000, let's split it three ways as usual'

expense.note: No payment_expense_link exists or ever will for this expense — no money moved through an Account Dev owns. This is a permanent, valid category (paid_by_person_id != Dev), not a transitional evidence-pending state. See docs/decisions/0006-bidirectional-payer-model.md.

allocation.note_on_cast: Flatmate C (joined 2026-07-01), not Flatmate B (moved out 2026-06-30), is the third beneficiary — consistent with fixtures/people-and-groups.json's group_memberships timeline for a 2026-07-16 expense.

resulting_obligations.note: Flatmate A's own line creates no obligation (invariants.md #2a — they benefited from their own money). Dev's and Flatmate C's lines each create an obligation OWED TO Flatmate A, not to Dev.

splitwise: Syncs as a normal shared expense from Flatmate A's perspective as the payer — Splitwise itself has always supported any member as the payer; this system previously could not represent that for its own ledger.
